posts.title: Football Buds BLITZ is coming
posts.text:
Football Buds is getting a full rebuild and a new name: Football Buds BLITZ. Forget real football. It's Buds vs Rivals, arcade style: loud, fast and totally ridiculous.
- Mystery powers. Answer right in the huddle to unlock power cards, then flip them to see what you got.
- Wild powers on the way, like Giant Bud, Rocket Cleats, Banana Peel and Freeze Ray.
- Get ON FIRE: string big plays together and the ball bursts into flames.
- Monster hits that send Rivals flying, and superhero dives into the end zone.
- Fumbles are live. Big hits knock the ball loose, and then it's a scramble.
- The field fills your whole screen, and every down deals you a new hand of plays.
- Your points come from the football. Every point on the scoreboard is worth 1,000, so touchdowns are everything.
Coming later: multiplayer. Play against your friends (or your enemies).
It's still in the lab, so it might get even crazier. It shows up here when it's ready.

posts.title: The fork just got bigger
posts.text:
Every run now has 9 rooms. Each side of the fork leads to a second room, and which side is which changes every run.
- Ember Kiln: Ember Imps only go down to your sword.
- Barracks: Lancers charge in a straight line all the way to the wall. Step out of the way.
- On fire? Roll to put it out.
- Fire hurts, but it can never knock you out on its own.

posts.title: Rook & Ruin teaser
posts.text: Sword runs through the dungeon. Right answers power your strikes.

posts.title: Star Swarm is getting rebuilt
posts.text:
A brand new Star Swarm is in the works.
- More flying, fewer stops for questions.
- A dash to slip through the swarm.
- Pick upgrades as you go.
A few students will test it first. It shows up here when it's ready.

posts.title: Snake Arena: full-screen arena
posts.text:
- The arena fills your whole screen.
- Every Rival hunts its own way: Cutters cut across your path, Coilers circle you, Snackers grow fast and run, Lurkers wait by an egg and pounce.
- A red ! means a Rival is coming for you.
- All-Pro mode: 1.5x points, but a wrong answer costs energy.
- 3 challenges every game, worth +1,000 each.
- Double points in the final 30 seconds.
- New events: Turbo Time and Bounty Blitz.

posts.title: How to get on the leaderboard
posts.text:
- Finish a run. The end screen tells you where you'd land on the leaderboard.
- Want to be on it? Send your score with your first name and last initial, like Levi S.
- Mr. Spitz checks every name before it shows up.
- Question sets marked ⭐ Suggested earn bonus points.
